name: Corporate Action Notification SD 6
definition: Provides additional information regarding notification general information details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: xPath to the element that is being extended.

ApprovedDate.name: Approved Date
ApprovedDate.definition: Date by which the announcement is set to approve event status.

MatchDate.name: Match Date
MatchDate.definition: Date used to match records from multiple vendors to the same event. It is typically the first key date on the event.

ActiveUntilDate.name: Active Until Date
ActiveUntilDate.definition: Date until which the event will remain in an active status on DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) system.

ServiceLevelAgreementPeriod.name: Service Level Agreement Period
ServiceLevelAgreementPeriod.definition: Start date and end date of the service level agreement.

ValidationNotSupportedReason.name: Validation Not Supported Reason
ValidationNotSupportedReason.definition: Specifies a reason why a corporate action will not be supported by the validation service. This is usually due to the event type or the product (security) type. The list of values will be provided externally to the schema.
